worked_solution:
The definition of $\operatorname{tanh}⁡x$ is 

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{tanh}⁡x & =\frac{{e}^{x}-{e}^{-x}}{{e}^{x}+{e}^{-x}} \\  & =\frac{{e}^{2x}-1}{{e}^{2x}+1} \\  & =\frac{1-{e}^{-2x}}{1+{e}^{-2x}}.\end{aligned}
$$

Using the third definition, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{tanh}⁡(-\operatorname{ln}⁡4) & =\frac{1-{e}^{-2(-\operatorname{ln}⁡4)}}{1+{e}^{-2(-\operatorname{ln}⁡4)}} \\  & =\frac{1-{e}^{2\operatorname{ln}⁡4}}{1+{e}^{2\operatorname{ln}⁡4}} \\  & =\frac{1-{e}^{\operatorname{ln}⁡{4}^{2}}}{1+{e}^{\operatorname{ln}⁡{4}^{2}}} \\  & =\frac{1-{e}^{\operatorname{ln}⁡16}}{1+{e}^{\operatorname{ln}⁡16}} \\  & =\frac{1-16}{1+16} \\  & =-\frac{15}{17}.\end{aligned}
$$
